title: [bundle] Fix doc-sync gap where agent guides and PRD/test docs still
objective: Fix doc-sync gap where agent guides and PRD/test docs still instruct the removed/unimplemented hf start command even though live hf start fails with unknown command. Replace hf start guidance with the current implemented session/worktree/navigation flow (hf session start where worktree session is intended, or claim/edit/checkpoint/test/drift/handoff where no separate start verb exists). Prove docs no longer tell agents to run hf start and live help remains clean.
acceptance_criteria: Agent-facing docs no longer instruct operators to run the unimplemented top-level hf start command.
Docs that describe worktree/session start use the implemented hf session start command or describe the claim/edit/checkpoint/test/drift/handoff flow without a separate start verb.
Live CLI evidence remains explicit that hf start is not a command while hf session help exits 0.
Docs changed are scoped to documentation and handoff evidence only.
test_commands: ! rg -n '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])hf start([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)' docs/USER_STORY.md docs/Continuity_Ledger_Kernel_PRD.md docs/TEST_MATRIX.md FLEET_GUIDE.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md
hf help session >/tmp/hf-help-session.out && rg -q "usage: hf session" /tmp/hf-help-session.out
